message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have any information on a “pet‑friendly” train station in Miami. Miami doesn’t have a conventional intercity train service—there’s only the local Metrorail and some freight lines—and none of those stations have a public pet‑policy. If you’re looking for a place to travel with a pet, you might want to check the pet rules for the specific train operator (e.g., Amtrak) rather than the station itself.
